description: Governor's Secretariat - Southern Province - Suspension of Post and Holding and Inquiry
categorisation: This gazette content involves the suspension of a local government councilor (Gange Sarath Sri Lal De Silva) and the appointment of a retired judicial officer to investigate potential misdemeanors under the Urban Council Ordinance. This falls under judicial/law enforcement matters as it deals with disciplinary actions against elected officials and judicial investigations, specifically involving the powers of a commission of inquiry.
